items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Trading Operations team is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant trade execution across all supported asset classes while protecting customers and the firm. The team partners closely with Engineering, Compliance, Customer Experience, and external market centers to maintain system stability and trading integrity during all market sessions. Robinhood has now introduced 24/7 trading and this hire will help support this new function. As a Trading Specialist, you will monitor live trading activity across overnight, extended hours, and regular market sessions while supporting the health of Robinhood’s trading infrastructure. You’ll investigate and resolve trading issues, coordinate responses to system or venue disruptions, and communicate clearly with internal teams and external partners. This role offers hands-on exposure to trading operations, risk management, and customer-impacting decisions, with meaningful opportunities for learning and career growth! This role is remote but will be tied to a local Robinhood office in New York, NY, Lake Mary, FL, Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. Shifts Available: Work Schedule 1 (all times are EST): Tuesday 11:30AM - 8:30PM Thursday 11:30AM - 8:30PM Saturday 9AM - 9PM Sunday 9AM - 9PM Work Schedule 2 (all times are EST): Friday 9pm - Sat 9am (Friday overnight to Saturday) Sat 9pm - Sun 9am (Saturday overnight to Sunday) Sunday 8pm - Mon 5am (Sunday overnight to Monday) Wednesday 8pm - Thurs 5am (Wednesday overnight to Thursday) What you’ll do Execution of Written Supervisory Procedures to comply with all SEC and FINRA rules Order entry and trade execution of equity and option orders Resolution of trade inquiries Monitor trading activity, firm accounts, corporate actions, and identify and resolve problems associated with trades Monitor health of routing systems and Venues, and interact with Venues as required Coordinate response for system, trading, and communications (SEV) related issues. Engage with cross functional teams (Product, Engineering, Compliance) on product development and problem solving. What you bring Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience 3-5 years working in a broker-dealer operations/trading environment FINRA Series 7 required FINRA 57 license required Strong understanding of brokerage operation functions Self-starter with ability to work independently Strong communication and analytical skills Ability to effectively prioritize and adapt to a changing environment What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.title: Founding Software Engineer, Physical Engineering
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Physical Engineering team sits within OpenAI’s Enterprise Verticals organization. We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products—shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish. Our initial focus is on mechanical and electrical engineering. We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with engineering software to help engineers move from early concepts through design, simulation, and preparation for production. We operate as a small founding team within OpenAI, working directly with customers and closely with research, design, and forward deployed engineers. We learn by building, putting products in users’ hands, and using their feedback to guide our next steps. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Founding Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll help define and build the product and technical foundations of this new vertical. You’ll work across frontend experiences, backend services, and integrations to bring AI into complex engineering workflows. You’ll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with product judgment and an eye for intuitive user experiences. Working directly with engineers and design partners, you’ll identify valuable problems, prototype solutions, and develop them into reliable products. We’re particularly interested in engineers who have built CAD, CAE, simulation, or other engineering design software. You should be comfortable owning work independently, making decisions with incomplete information, and moving between product details and system architecture. This is an opportunity to shape a new product area from its earliest stages, with significant influence over what we build, how it works, and the team we become. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build and ship full-stack AI products that help mechanical and electrical engineers work through design and simulation tasks. - Own projects from customer discovery and prototyping through production deployment and iteration. - Create intuitive interfaces that help users understand, inspect, and refine complex engineering outputs. - Develop backend services, APIs, plugins, and integrations that connect OpenAI models with engineering software. - Work directly with customers to understand engineering constraints, identify valuable applications, and translate specific needs into broadly useful products. - Partner with research, design, platform, and forward deployed engineering teams to bring emerging AI capabilities into practical workflows. - Evaluate quality and reliability, using customer feedback and product evidence to understand whether we’re improving how engineers work. - Help establish the technical foundations and engineering practices of a growing team. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have independently built and shipped substantial software products, with ownership across frontend and backend systems. - Bring strong product instincts and UI judgment, especially for tools that make complex work easier to understand and perform. - Enjoy working directly with users and translating their needs into thoughtful product and technical decisions. - Can turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear starting point and a working product. - Move quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and stay accountable for quality after launch. - Learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and communicate clearly across disciplines. - Are excited about applying frontier AI to the design and development of physical products. PARTICULARLY RELEVANT EXPERIENCE - Building CAD, CAE, simulation, electrical design, or related professional software. - Developing interactive tools for visual, spatial, or technically complex workflows. - Connecting engineering tools through APIs, plugins, or extensions. - Building AI-powered applications and evaluating their usefulness and reliability. - Taking a product from concept to production as a founder or early engineer. items.title: Site Reliability Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role We are seeking highly experienced Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) to shape the reliability, scalability and performance of our platform and customer facing applications. You will work closely with our software engineers and research teams to ensure our systems meet and exceed our internal and external customers' expectations. What You Will Do As a Site Reliability Engineer, you balance the day-to-day operations on production systems with long-term software engineering improvements to reduce operational toil and foster the reliability, availability, and performance of these systems. Operations • Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available and fault-tolerant infrastructures to support our web services and ML workloads • Make sure our platform, inference and model training environments are always highly available and enable seamless replication of work environments across several HPC clusters • Operate systems and troubleshoot issues in production environments (interrupts, on-call responses, users admin, data extraction, infrastructure scaling, etc.) • Implement and improve monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems to ensure optimal system performance and minimize downtime • Implement and maintain workflows and tools (CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, monitoring, logging and alerting systems) for both our client-facing APIs and large training runs • Participate occasionally in on-call rotations to respond to incidents and perform root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences Development • Drive continuous improvement in infrastructure automation, deployment, and orchestration using tools like Kubernetes, Flux, Terraform • Collaborate with AI/ML researchers to develop and implement solutions that enable safe and reproducible model-training experiments • Build a cloud-agnostic platform offering an abstraction layer between science and infrastructure • Design and develop new workflows and tooling to improve to the reliability, availability and performance of our systems (automation scripts, refactoring, new API-based features, web apps, dashboards, etc.) • Collaborate with the security team to ensure infrastructure adheres to best security practices and compliance requirements • Document processes and procedures to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing across the team • Contribute to open-source projects, research publications, blog articles and conferences What We're Looking For • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field • 7+ years of experience in a DevOps/SRE role • Strong experience with cloud computing and highly available distributed systems • Exposure to site reliability issues in critical environments (issue root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...) • Experience working against reliability KPIs (observability, alerting, SLAs) • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes...) • Knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog...) • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Go, Bash...) and knowledge of software development best practices • Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration concepts • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills • Self-motivated and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have: • experience in an AI/ML environment • experience of high-performance computing (HPC) systems and workload managers (Slurm) • worked with modern AI-oriented solutions (Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast...) Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Regional Security Manager, APAC
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As the Regional Security Manager, APAC, you'll lead the development and execution of Coinbase's regional security strategy on the Global Security team, protecting our people, workplaces, and operations across a diverse and rapidly evolving region. You'll own the physical security program for APAC offices, critical facilities, and data centers, partnering with business leaders and cross-functional teams to manage risk, strengthen resilience, and drive incident response across multiple countries. What you'll do: Own the APAC physical security operating plan, regional risk register, site security standards, and remediation priorities across offices, critical facilities, and data centers. Lead site assessments, vulnerability reviews, security hardening projects, new office openings, relocations, and security system deployments across the region. Serve as the regional escalation point and Incident Commander for significant security events, coordinating the GSOC, workplace teams, vendors, building management, and emergency services. Govern regional access control, badging, visitor management, secure area access, and audit readiness while managing contracted security providers through SLAs, KPIs, and QBRs. Develop and maintain regional policies, SOPs, playbooks, drills, tabletop exercises, and employee-facing security guidance informed by APAC threat intelligence and local conditions. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years in physical security, risk, or resilience operations within a multinational organization, including 5+ years leading APAC regional security programs across multiple countries and sites. Proven experience serving as Incident Commander during complex, cross-functional, or high-consequence security events with documented outcomes. Hands-on experience implementing and managing access control, CCTV, alarm, visitor management, and guard force systems across multiple facilities. Direct experience conducting risk and vulnerability assessments and converting findings into measurable, time-bound remediation plans. Track record managing security vendors through SLAs, KPIs, QBRs, performance improvement plans, and contract renewals in APAC markets. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase Corporate Security (CorpSec) is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to build and maintain security controls that protect corporate infrastructure, user devices, enterprise applications, and network communications. You'll partner closely with IT and engineering teams to identify risks and ship tailored solutions that keep users secure without introducing unnecessary friction, directly protecting Coinbase's most sensitive data and critical assets. What you'll do: Design, implement, and maintain security solutions to harden Coinbase's macOS, Chromebook, and mobile endpoints, focusing on secure configurations, compliance, threat detection, and user experience. Perform security reviews on enterprise systems and software that enable user productivity across the corporate environment. Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate endpoint and SaaS security into broader corporate engineering initiatives. Identify and close data exfiltration paths introduced by local AI agents and developer tooling (e.g., coding assistants, LLM harnesses) running on corporate endpoints. Provide technical guidance and code review support to engineers on the CorpSec team, raising the security bar across the organization. Proven ability to write production code (services, integrations, automations) that supports corporate infrastructure security. Experience scoping, prioritizing, and shipping security projects end-to-end with minimal direction in fast-moving environments. Familiarity with device trust, zero trust network access, or endpoint communication security products (e.g., Cloudflare, Prisma Access, Zscaler). items.location_text: Mountain View, CA; San Francisco, CA
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role Glean is looking for a Senior Social Media Manager to own and grow our organic social presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll be the voice behind Glean's brand channels and a key partner to our executives and technical leaders, turning product launches, company moments, and market conversations into content that educates, celebrates, and inspires the use of Work AI. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves fluidly between real-time execution (live-posting a launch event) and longer-range program building (scaling an employee advocacy program, standing up a technical social-listening motion). You'll report to the Director of Communications and work closely with Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, PR, Sales, and R&D to make sure Glean shows up consistently and credibly everywhere our audience is paying attention. You Will: Own Glean's always-on content calendar and organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, aligned to our content pillars: educate, celebrate, and inspire the use of Glean's Work AI platform. Create and edit lightweight, platform-native multimedia content - including short-form video, clips, graphics, and other social-first assets - using tools such as Capcut, Canva, or other. Manage executive social media presence for Glean's CEO and other company spokespeople — ghostwriting, scheduling, and coordinating posts that tie technical and company narratives to the broader Work AI story. Lead live social coverage for major company moments, including product launches, Monthly Drops, and flagship events (e.g., Glean:GO), publishing and amplifying content in real time across channels. Own and scale Glean's employee advocacy program (currently run via Oktopost) — onboarding and training advocates, curating ready-to-share content, managing the licensing/vendor relationship and renewals, and reporting on reach, engagement, and pipeline attribution (in partnership with Sales/SFDC). Build and run a technical social-listening and rapid-response motion (e.g., a "Glean Gurus"-style program) with R&D and PMM, surfacing and engaging in relevant conversations on X, Reddit, and other technical forums. Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to train employees on social best practices and personal branding, and run onboarding sessions on how to engage safely and effectively on behalf of the brand. Manage relationships with outside agencies or contractors supporting content production, cross-posting, and coverage during high-volume periods. Track and report on social performance (reach, engagement, follower growth, and pipeline/revenue influence) and translate insights into content and channel strategy recommendations. Monitor brand sentiment and competitive conversation, applying sound judgment on when and how to engage, and act as a first line of defense on social-related reputational risk. Collaborate cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, and R&D to ensure social amplifies — and helps shape — the broader company narrative. About You: 6+ years of experience managing organic social media for a B2B or enterprise technology/SaaS brand, ideally with direct ownership of a corporate LinkedIn and X presence. Experience managing or ghostwriting for executive social accounts, with strong instincts for voice, tone, and what's appropriate to post on a leader's behalf. Experience running or scaling an employee advocacy or social amplification program (e.g., Oktopost, EveryoneSocial, GaggleAMP) with measurable results. Comfort operating in real time — live-posting events, responding quickly to trending conversations, and making fast, sound judgment calls under time pressure. Strong writing skills and an editorial eye, with the ability to translate technical or dense product content into clear, platform-native copy. A data-driven approach to social, with experience using analytics tools to measure performance and tie social activity to pipeline or business outcomes. Experience partnering cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering/R&D stakeholders. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to quickly understand complex AI, product, and engineering concepts and translate them into accurate, accessible, and compelling social content. Vendor and budget management experience (agencies, social tooling contracts) is a plus. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office). Availability for occasional evening/early-morning coverage around major launches and events. Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $198,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Money Movement team builds the products that let customers move money and assets into, out of, and within Robinhood. Our work spans the infrastructure and partner integrations underneath and the experiences customers see on top, and we partner closely with design, data science, compliance, and fraud. Moving money is where customers decide whether they trust a product, and we want it to feel as good as investing. We care a lot about removing friction. A transfer should be fast and easy to follow, with the kind of polish customers notice. Everything else customers do at Robinhood starts here, so we want it to be something they enjoy. As a Senior Product Manager on the customer experience side of Money Movement, you will set the vision for how moving money feels and deliver experiences customers find clear and delightful. You will lead zero-to-one launches, own the end-to-end journey across mobile and web, and sweat the details, from the copy and motion to the states in between. You will partner with design, engineering, legal, and operations to ensure what we ship is compliant and a pleasure to use. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for Robinhood's money movement customer experience, spanning funding, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers Lead zero-to-one product initiatives that make moving money faster and more delightful, from first concept through launch Partner closely with design to shape the work, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft and interaction detail Drive significant improvements in funnel conversion, transaction success, and customer satisfaction by finding friction and failure points in the journey and using research, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize Partner with engineering and the platform teams that own our payment rails and vendor integrations to turn platform capabilities into reliable, fast customer-facing experiences Work with compliance, legal, and fraud teams to ensure every experience meets regulatory requirements without compromising the customer experience What you bring Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in a product management role, with a proven track record of shipping consumer products that customers love, ideally mobile-first A history of close collaboration with design: you partner with designers from concept to launch, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft Exceptional attention to detail and strong product taste, with examples of experiences you shaped where polish made a measurable difference Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated consumer space is a plus; you do not need to be a payments expert, and you will learn the rest quickly High technical empathy and experience partnering closely with engineering to resolve complex tradeoffs and deliver clean user experiences Familiarity using user research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide decision making Demonstrated ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, formulate opinionated product recommendations, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders A strong sense of urgency and speed, high standards, and a strong work ethic: you always bring your best and expect your colleagues to do the same Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering, operations, and external partners What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Infra - SF
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development. About the role Forward Deployed Engineers lead complex deployments of frontier models in production. You will embed with customers where model performance matters, delivery is urgent, and ambiguity is the default. You will use this to map their problems, structure delivery, and ship fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer for AI Infra, you will work directly with customer engineers, researchers and product engineers on optimization problems across semiconductors and AI infrastructure. You will write and debug software, run experiments against real workloads and hardware, and improve the tools and product used across engagements. You will help define the problem and success criteria, build the software needed to test an approach, and stay with the work through validation and deployment. Work may include inference performance and chip-design optimization. Success means producing results that stand up to correctness and performance checks, and contributing improvements that other engagements can use. Success in this role means owning the delivery state across workstreams. You will hold the bar on quality and pace and help OpenAI learn through execution. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role, you will: - Own technical delivery for agreed semiconductor and AI-infrastructure workstreams, from initial scoping and prototypes through validation, production deployment and adoption. - Work closely with customer engineers to understand their workflows and constraints, define workloads, baselines and success criteria, and help what you build become part of how they work. - Scope and sequence delivery, identify dependencies and blockers early, and make practical trade-offs between scope, speed and quality as the work develops. - Personally build and debug production-quality software, including harnesses, integrations and product features that apply frontier models to problems in chip design, verification, inference and performance engineering. - Design reproducible experiments, evaluations, graders and benchmarks to test approaches, validate correctness and performance, and establish whether improvements hold up in real engineering environments. - Investigate model behavior and failure modes alongside researchers, contributing evaluation or training data and targeted experiments where they can improve the underlying capability. - Contribute directly to core product development, working with product engineers to resolve tooling gaps, ship useful improvements and bring field learning into product decisions. - Lead technical discussions and maintain alignment across customer, Product and Research teams. Build the domain and product fluency to explain capabilities, limitations and results, and keep ownership, risks and next steps clear. - Turn successful approaches into reusable software, tools and playbooks, reducing the effort needed for future engagements and helping customer teams operate what has been built. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work - Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments - Write and review production-grade software, and debug unfamiliar systems across code, integrations and runtime behavior. - Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience - Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure - Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders - Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down - Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high - Have a strong product sense and have contributed towards productizing efforts - Have hands-on experience with applied machine learning, model evaluation, data quality, experimentation, or model-behavior analysis - Can turn an ambiguous technical problem into a clear evaluation, a credible baseline, and a reproducible experiment - Are comfortable learning unfamiliar technical domains and working closely with researchers, product engineers and customer engineers. Experience in semiconductor development, data-center systems or inference engineering is helpful. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard. Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market: - Managing uncertainty: Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record - Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly - Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap. - Builder mentality: We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge - Team work: Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below. THE OPPORTUNITY - Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies - Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends - Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods - Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement - Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.) - Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market - Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring WHAT YOU BRING - Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org - High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing - High motor - Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities - Strong product sense - Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics - High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise. - Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting - Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Casino Specialist
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Casino Specialist to join our team in Malta. Reporting directly to the Casino Manager, you will sit at the intersection of product operations, commercial strategy, and provider management. In this role, you will take full ownership of day-to-day operations across assigned markets and brands. Your focus will be keeping our lobbies fresh and commercially optimized, coordinating game releases, troubleshooting operational issues, and partnering with game providers to secure promotional budgets and exclusive games. This is an ideal position for someone with solid gaming product experience who enjoys autonomy, works well under pressure, and wants to make an immediate impact on our core casino performance. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Managing daily casino operations across assigned markets, ensuring seamless game launches and optimal lobby positioning. - Building strong relationships with game providers to negotiate marketing co-funding, promotional campaigns, and exclusive releases. - Monitoring product performance metrics and delivering clear, actionable presentations to commercial cluster teams. - Acting as the main point of escalation for operational bugs, digging into root causes, and resolving issues directly with providers. - Collaborating closely with Marketing, Delivery, and Compliance teams to launch new initiatives smoothly and compliantly. - Representing LeoVegas Group at industry conferences and evening partner networking events. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - 1–2+ years of hands-on experience in iGaming product operations, casino coordination, or gaming delivery. - Strong commercial understanding of casino games, lobby management, and promotional mechanics. - Practical experience tracking product KPIs, analyzing performance data, and presenting insights to internal stakeholders. - Excellent organizational skills with the confidence to prioritize tasks, set clear boundaries, and solve problems independently. - Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills, with a genuine interest in building external provider relationships. NICE TO HAVES - Hands-on experience with front-end CMS tools (such as Redstone) or casino back-office platforms. - Existing network across top game suppliers, or experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g. Claude) to optimize daily workflows. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please
